author: Khan Academy
description:
Think AI is just about automation? Think again. Dr. Amy Alzina, Supt. of Cold Spring School District, shares a moving story about using AI to amplify the voices of her teachers.

By using AI to capture the fine details of a classroom observation, Dr. Alzina was able to provide feedback so personalized and thorough that it moved her teacher to tears. To hear more about how Dr. Alzina is using AI to enhance the "Human-AI-Human" connection with her staff and students, and see how technology can make our educators feel more seen and valued than ever before, join her for a webinar with Khan Academy Founder Sal Khan on March 27.
title: Can AI Enhance the Human Connection in Teacher Evaluations?
